verdict.rationale: Airwallex ships 'AgentOS', a toolkit letting AI agents act on production accounts (read balances, create beneficiaries, issue cards, build cashflow reports) plus developer connectors wiring Airwallex docs/sandbox into Cursor, Claude Code, Codex and similar NL-driven coding agents. This shows genuine agentic/NL-operable infrastructure, but it's a developer toolkit/connector rather than a turnkey natural-language interface for end users. Missing for 10: a first-party consumer-facing chat/NL command interface, independent hands-on validation of AgentOS commands succeeding, and detail on breadth of supported natural-language actions.
